new_constructors.name: source_other_recipients

new_constructors.meaning: The material class bounded by the enclosed exact current-source wording when ordinary confidential-information, copy, or derivative constructors would change its scope.
new_constructors.name: source_stated_information

new_constructors.meaning: Expiration or termination of the source-defined Project, distinct from Agreement termination and from a general business relationship ending.
new_constructors.name: project_end

new_constructors.meaning: The enclosed trigger subject to the exact source-stated deadline, ordering, or other temporal qualification retained as text.
new_constructors.name: qualified_trigger

new_constructors.meaning: An operative role, purpose, or applicability condition retained in exact current-source wording when a narrower existing condition would overstate it.
new_constructors.name: source_stated_condition

new_constructors.meaning: A current-source clause whose wording places stated persons within a confidentiality context but omits enough language that no disclosure permission or prohibition is supplied by the program.

rationale: 本次更新不再增加对当前 G 无因果影响的神经读取，而是在查询前直接补齐来源局部语义。程序保留全部 incoming statements，并新增：6fce 中相互独立的请求返还、Project 结束后限期销毁、Agreement 结束/请求返还、备份档案留存、法务部门争议副本留存及持续保密限定；8fb 中仅由请求触发的全部材料返还，并把其省略式人员保密句保留为未解析描述；a5b0 中 Visitor 对来源所称“others”的明确披露禁止，同时不把它扩张为员工、顾问或一般第三方类别。处置动作分别绑定自己的材料、触发、期限和例外，受控实体角色也不扁平化。组合阶段只转发已类型检查的来源输出，消费者继续保留既有正、负和未处理残差路径；没有完整证据时不会制造 NotMentioned。该更新未运行 U，U 的 phi/G 字典仍为空，也不承诺总体得分提升；尤其 8fb 不会为匹配原生标注而虚构 Agreement 终止事件，省略式句子和其他未覆盖解释仍进入 residual。

def source_find_following(spans, start, phrases, limit):
    stop = min(len(spans), start + limit + 1)
    i = start + 1
    while i < stop:
        span = spans[i]
        raw = span.get('text', '') if isinstance(span, dict) else ''
        text = source_low(raw)
        if source_any(text, phrases):
            return i
        i += 1
    return -1

def apply(inputs, premises):
    source_output = inputs.get('source_output', {})
    statements = []
    unresolved = []
    complete = True
    if isinstance(source_output, dict):
        complete = bool(source_output.get('complete', False))
        for row in source_output.get('statements', []):
            if isinstance(row, dict) and isinstance(row.get('term'), list):
                source_add(statements, row.get('term'), row.get('support_ids', []))
        for item in source_output.get('unresolved', []):
            if isinstance(item, str) and item not in unresolved:
                unresolved.append(item)
    spans = []
    for span in inputs.get('source_spans', []):
        if isinstance(span, dict):
            spans.append(span)
    i = 0
    while i < len(spans):
        span = spans[i]
        uid = span.get('id')
        raw = span.get('text', '')
        if not isinstance(raw, str):
            raw = str(raw)
        text = source_low(raw)
        actor = source_actor(raw)
        if 'if requested' in text and 'return any and all materials' in text:
            material = ['source_stated_information', raw]
            action = ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']]
            trigger = ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']]
            source_add(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], action, trigger, ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
        if source_any(text, ['obligations of the parties shall be to hold and maintain', 'obligations of the parties shall be to hold']) and 'need to know' in text and source_any(text, ['agents', 'employees', 'representatives', 'affiliates']) and not source_any(text, ['may disclose', 'may be disclosed', 'except to']):
            source_add(statements, ['source_elliptical_clause', raw], [uid])
            message = 'Elliptical recipient-confidentiality wording remains unresolved in current unit ' + str(uid)
            if message not in unresolved:
                unresolved.append(message)
            complete = False
        if 'will not without' in text and 'confidential information' in text and source_any(text, ['reveal such confidential information to others', 'divulge such confidential information to others']):
            recipient = ['source_other_recipients', raw]
            action = ['disclose', ['confidential_information'], recipient]
            exception = ['exception_set', ['authorization_exception', raw]]
            source_add(statements, ['prohibition', actor, action, ['no_condition'], exception], [uid])
        if 'shall be returned to the disclosing party upon request or destroyed within' in text and source_any(text, ['termination of the project', 'expiration or other termination of the project', 'expiration of the project']):
            material = source_bundle(True, False)
            return_action = ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']]
            destroy_action = ['destroy', material]
            source_add(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], return_action, ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']], ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
            destroy_trigger = ['qualified_trigger', ['project_end'], raw]
            source_add(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], destroy_action, destroy_trigger, ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
        if source_any(text, ['not be required to delete electronic confidential information stored in back-up/archival storage', 'not be required to delete electronic confidential information stored in backup/archival storage']):
            material = ['source_stated_information', raw]
            condition = ['retention_condition', raw]
            source_add(statements, ['retention_permission', ['receiving_party'], material, ['after_disposal'], condition], [uid])
        if 'single copy of all confidential information may be retained' in text and 'legal department' in text and 'dispute resolution' in text:
            material = ['source_stated_information', raw]
            condition = ['retention_condition', raw]
            source_add(statements, ['retention_permission', ['receiving_party'], material, ['after_disposal'], condition], [uid])
        if source_any(text, ['upon written demand by the disclosing party or upon termination of this confidentiality agreement', 'upon written demand by the disclosing party or upon termination of the agreement']):
            j = source_find_following(spans, i, ['return the confidential information and all copies', 'return confidential information and all copies'], 3)
            if j >= 0:
                next_span = spans[j]
                next_uid = next_span.get('id')
                next_raw = next_span.get('text', '')
                if not isinstance(next_raw, str):
                    next_raw = str(next_raw)
                material = source_bundle(True, True)
                action = ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']]
                request_trigger = ['qualified_trigger', ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']], next_raw]
                source_add(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], action, request_trigger, ['no_exceptions']], [uid, next_uid])
                source_add(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], action, ['agreement_termination'], ['no_exceptions']], [uid, next_uid])
        if 'shall cause such corporate affiliate to return or destroy all confidential information' in text and source_any(text, ['if requested by the disclosing party', 'upon request by the disclosing party']):
            affiliate = ['controlled_entities_of', ['receiving_party']]
            material = ['confidential_information']
            action = ['action_alternative', ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']], ['destroy', material]]
            trigger = ['qualified_trigger', ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']], raw]
            source_add(statements, ['disposal_obligation', affiliate, action, trigger, ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
        if 'except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents' in text and 'confidential information' in text:
            roles = []
            roles.append(['employees_of', ['receiving_party']])
            roles.append(['officers_of', ['receiving_party']])
            roles.append(['directors_of', ['receiving_party']])
            roles.append(['consultants_of', ['receiving_party']])
            roles.append(['affiliates_of', ['receiving_party']])
            roles.append(['agents_of', ['receiving_party']])
            recipients = source_union(roles)
            conditions = ['source_stated_condition', raw]
            support = [uid]
            j = source_find_following(spans, i, ['agreed to be bound in writing under terms no less stringent', 'bound in writing under terms no less stringent'], 3)
            if j >= 0:
                safeguard_span = spans[j]
                safeguard_raw = safeguard_span.get('text', '')
                if not isinstance(safeguard_raw, str):
                    safeguard_raw = str(safeguard_raw)
                conditions = ['and_condition', conditions, ['confidentiality_bound', safeguard_raw]]
                support.append(safeguard_span.get('id'))
            permission = ['permission', ['receiving_party'], ['disclose', ['confidential_information'], recipients], conditions]
            source_add(statements, permission, support)
        i += 1
    return {'statements': statements, 'complete': complete and len(unresolved) == 0, 'unresolved': source_unique(unresolved)}
